property_summary: Deposits are cumulative: after any sequence of deposits, balances[msg.sender] equals the sum of all deposited values; the mutant overwrites so a second deposit fails to add to the prior balance.
After two deposits of amounts a and b (each above MinDeposit) by the same actor, the actor's recorded balance must equal a+b; the mutant overwrites the balance so it equals b instead.
